meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (National Unitary Jurisdiction; International Companies Regime administered in Apia)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English Common Law foundation as modified by fa'a Samoa (indigenous Samoan custom), statute law, and limited civil-codification elements; Supreme Court of Samoa retains ultimate appellate jurisdiction.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Bilateral Investment Treaty between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Independent State of Samoa (in force)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Samoa and Australia
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Samoa and New Zealand
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) — multilateral trade and economic development treaty applicable to Samoa

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended); International Companies Regulations 1998 (as amended); Samoa International Financial Authority Act 2013; Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007; Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2016; Financial Intelligence Unit (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2018; SIFA AML/CFT Handbook; obligations implemented in alignment with Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) mutual evaluation standards.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copy of Passport of each director, shareholder, a+nd authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin certifying a passport issued by the competent national passport authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the designated Competent Authority of the country of origin; where the origin country is not a Hague Contracting Party, consular legalization by the nearest Samoan High Commission, Embassy, or the Permanent Mission of Samoa to the United Nations, New York

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copy of Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum/Articles of Association, and Certificate of Good Standing of any corporate shareholder or corporate director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry of the country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization through the applicable Samoan diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the SIFA-licensed Samoan registered agent and corporate service provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of execution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter and Account Verification Statement from the principal banking relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account-holding licensed bank in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank official seal and signature, followed by notarization and Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified English/Samoan translation of any non-English corporate, identity, or constitutional document (including Chinese-language charter texts)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified translator or notary public with certified translation credentials in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization of the translator's/notary's signature

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-engagement and ongoing screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and authorized signatories against (i) the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit Domestic Designated Persons List, (ii) the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, (iii) the OFAC SDN List, (iv) EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions lists, and (v) international PEP databases. Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) is mandatory where any principal is a non-resident foreign person, a senior public official (PEP), a family member or close associate of a PEP, or a resident of a high-risk jurisdiction. Source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation must be retained for all foreign principals, and suspicious transaction reports must be filed with the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit under the Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2016.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) Company Registry — name clearance is processed exclusively through SIFA-licensed registered agents; the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) e-Registry applies only to domestic Samoan companies, not International Companies.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Company legal names must be rendered in Roman (Latin) script using English or Samoan words. Chinese-character or other non-Latin script is not accepted in the registrable legal name; a romanized transliteration (e.g., pinyin) must be submitted, accompanied by a certified translation where a foreign-language element is embedded. Bilingual and all-Chinese internal governing documents may be adopted as constitutional instruments, provided the English version is the controlling text for registration and statutory filings. The legal name must end with 'Limited,' 'Corporation,' 'Incorporated,' or an accepted abbreviation denoting limited liability, and must be distinguishable from all names already on the SIFA register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Where the Registrar of International Companies refuses a proposed name, the licensed agent receives a written refusal citing the statutory ground under the International Companies Act 1987. The applicant may, through the licensed agent, submit a written request for reconsideration to the Registrar within 14 days of the date of refusal, attaching the prior search reports, any evidence of lawful entitlement, and the certificate of the romanized transliteration. If reconsideration is denied, a formal administrative appeal may be lodged with the Minister responsible for the Samoa International Financial Authority within 30 days of the reconsideration decision. A final application for judicial review may be made to the Supreme Court of Samoa. In parallel, the applicant may immediately submit a revised or alternative name accompanied by a fresh name-clearance application without forfeiting priority.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not permissible as the statutory registered office. Under the International Companies Act 1987 and the Samoa International Financial Authority Act 2013, every International Company must at all times maintain a registered office in Samoa consisting of the physical address of its SIFA-licensed registered agent. For the target Print-on-Demand (POD) custom merchandise retail business, all commercial functions, production, warehousing, and e-commerce operations may lawfully be conducted remotely and outside Samoa; no physical business presence within Samoa is required for the International Company structure.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. Unannounced physical inspections are conducted principally by the SIFA supervisory team at the premises of licensed registered agents during AML/CFT compliance examinations, and may be triggered by adverse intelligence, sanctions hits, or a high-risk ultimate beneficial owner profile. For a single-shareholder, low-risk POD retail International Company with a clean PEP/sanctions screening outcome, the estimated annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection is below 5%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and reserved-name application (one proposed name with romanized transliteration)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) Company Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per International Companies Regulations 1998, collected through the licensed registered agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation and registration filing fee covering Memorandum and Articles of Association
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule under the International Companies Act 1987

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Apostille/consular legalization bundle for five KYC documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and designated Competent Authority for Apostilles in the country of origin; Samoan diplomatic missions where consular legalization applies
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for notarial, authentication, and consular fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO profiling, PEP/OFAC/UN sanctions screening, and AML/CFT risk assessment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; mandated by the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 and the SIFA AML/CFT Handbook

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Statutory registered office service in Samoa — first year
Licensed registered agent engagement, client acceptance, compliance administration, and annual regulatory filings — first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for Samoan corporate service providers

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Secure diplomatic/courier transmission of original legalized documents from country of origin to Samoa
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: International courier or government dispatch service

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English/Samoan translation allowance for any foreign-language constituent documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translator in Samoa or the country of origin

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), ss.7, 12, 23, 34; International Companies (Amendment) Act 2017
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies and International Companies Division, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Combined Constitution) filed as Form IC-1
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for International Companies; share capital may be expressed in any currency and need not be paid up or escrowed at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company adopts the Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed. RESOLVED FURTHER that the subscriber's share subscription be and is hereby accepted, and one ordinary share be allotted to the founding subscriber. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office and registered agent of the Company be established at the address of the licensed registered agent and continue until changed. RESOLVED FURTHER that [Director Name] and [Officer Name] be and are hereby appointed as the first directors, and [Secretary Name] as Corporate Secretary, each to serve until the next annual general meeting. RESOLVED FURTHER that the officers be authorized to execute all filings and open bank accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL (via licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed registered agent submits an online name search to the Registry to confirm the proposed corporate name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing company or protected statutory word. If available, file a name reservation application and pay the reservation fee.
required_dossiers: Statutory declaration of name availability from registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected, the agent resubmits with an alternative name within 3 business days; no additional government fee is charged for a single resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and notarization of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Samoa / respective consular notarization via registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association and subscriber details. The founding subscriber executes the document before a notary public, or via apostilled execution if outside Samoa. The licensed registered agent provides a consent to act in the prescribed form.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Residential address proof (utility bill or bank statement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries the notarization or signature authentication, cure by re-execution before a Samoan notary or by obtaining an apostille/legalization certificate and resubmitting within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of incorporation application and payment of government fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL (online portal or physical submissions window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the executed constitutional documents, compliance declaration, and filing confirmation with the Registry through the designated IC e-portal, together with the government incorporation fee. The agent ensures all required fields and statutory declarations are complete before submission.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Declaration of compliance signed by the recorder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a notice of insufficiency, the agent must respond within 14 days with correcting documents or evidence of legalization; on failure to respond the application lapses and a new filing fee is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and post-registration corporate governance actions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registry issues the Certificate of Incorporation, a Certified True Copy of the constitution, and a certificate of good standing. The company then holds its first board meeting to adopt the resolution above, appoints directors and officers, and opens a bank account.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles
First board minutes or written resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical errors, submit an application for re-issuance with a statutory declaration from the registered agent, and the Registry issues a corrected Certificate within 3 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for offshore International Company; if domestic physical production is later established, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) and the Samoa Bureau of Standards would apply.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating license required for an International Company conducting offshore retail activities under Section 15 of the International Companies Act 1987.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt for pure offshore POD retail; Registration tier (EIA Registration) only if an apparel printing facility is physically established in Samoa.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable unless domestic production occurs; if triggered, compliance with Water Quality Regulations 2018 (pH 6.0-9.0, TSS < 50 mg/L) and Air Quality Regulations 2017 (VOC limit 50 mg/m3).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable because no local physical premises; if a future local print shop is established, fire safety certification from the Fire Services, structural inspection by the Building Division, and workplace clearance from the Department of Labour are mandatory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MfR), Samoa — official e-services portal: www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Obtain SIFA-issued Incorporation Certificate through an MfR/SIFA-licensed registered agent. Submit Form TIN-01 to the MfR with the certified passport page of each director, the Incorporation Certificate, the Certificate of Registered Agent/Registered Office, and the entity's physical and email addresses; the TIN is issued in 2-5 business days free of charge. VAGST registration is filed via Form VAG-01 where annual taxable turnover in Samoa exceeds the statutory threshold or where a voluntary registration is sought; an International Company that makes only offshore zero-rated export sales may lawfully operate without local VAGST registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election is available under Samoan law. The exemption under the International Companies Act 1987, s.173 (complete relief from income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, and withholding taxes, together with exemption from filing any income returns) is automatic, irrevocable, and not open to an entity-classification election. The only available election is voluntary registration for VAGST under the VAGST Act 2004, which may be elected for refund recovery on local input costs.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 of annual taxable supplies in Samoa; voluntary registration permitted below threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, or digital stamping mandate exists in Samoa. A valid tax invoice must show the supplier TIN and recipient TIN, issue date, unique sequential number, description, quantity, unit price, and VAGST at 15%; electronic invoices are accepted and all records must be retained for 5 years. VAGST returns are filed online through the MfR e-services portal on a monthly or quarterly basis, but the MfR applies retrospective audit clearance rather than per-invoice government authorization.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: (1) Goods: physical export from Samoa within 30 days of supply with title passing to a non-resident located outside Samoa, supported by customs and transport evidence; (2) Offshore POD retailing services: e-commerce order-taking, customer acquisition, and fulfilment agency services supplied to a non-resident with the place of supply outside Samoa and benefit wholly consumed offshore (covering scenarios where the proximate print/fulfilment operation occurs abroad) qualify as zero-rated offshore services. A VAGST-registered IC may claim a refund of input VAGST on local costs attributable to such zero-rated export or offshore service supplies.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Samoa Customs Export Declaration (Form EX-001) — required where goods are physically exported from Samoa
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill dated within 30 days of the tax invoice, evidencing the Samoa export movement for goods zero-rating
Commercial tax invoice marked 'Zero Rated — Export / Offshore Services', showing supplier TIN and the non-resident customer's foreign address
Inward remittance certificate or foreign currency bank credit advice (PayPal/Stripe settlement reports accepted only when corroborated by bank statements) evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Print-on-demand production and freight invoices substantiating input VAGST claimed in the refund application
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The MfR audits zero-rated claims by tracing goods to customs export records; failure to substantiate the zero rate recharacterizes the supply as taxable at 15% with output VAGST assessed. Shortfall penalties under the Tax Administration Act 2012 range from 25% of the deficiency for failure to take reasonable care up to 75% for intentional disregard or concealment, plus monthly late-payment interest; refunds may be retrospectively clawed back by assessment for up to 5 years, without limitation in fraud cases. Criminal prosecution for fraudulent export zero-rating carries fines of up to double the tax evaded and/or imprisonment of up to 5 years, and unrepatriated proceeds beyond the 180-day window separately constitute an Exchange Control Act 1976 offence with Central Bank of Samoa penalties and increased customs audit exposure.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), exercising delegated authority from the Minister of Finance under the Exchange Control Act 1976 and prudential supervision over licensed authorized dealers under the Financial Institutions Act 1996.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is a partially convertible managed-float currency. Current-account transactions, including trade settlements and marketplace payouts, are statutorily delegated to licensed authorized dealers and are routinely approved. Capital-account transactions, such as equity injections and shareholder loan repayments, require CBS approval on a case-by-case basis; approval is routinely granted for bona fide International Company treasury flows. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 is deemed non-resident for exchange-control purposes, may contract and hold balances in any currency, and operates USD-denominated clearing accounts outside the WST conversion net. Profit remittance: dividends paid by an IC to non-resident shareholders are exempt from all Samoan taxes and transferable without a CBS capital-account permit when funded from foreign-currency balances; conversion of WST dividends requires only a declaration to an authorized dealer, not a CBS permit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender ratio applies to an IC's export or trade proceeds under the Exchange Control Act 1976; an IC is expressly exempt from the resident exporter's duty to sell foreign currency to an authorized dealer. The statutory export-proceeds timeline requiring repatriation within 6 months of shipment applies only to resident Samoan exporters; a POD IC selling via Stripe and PayPal to end-customers is treated as having no deemed export from Samoa. Any incidental WST-denominated sales proceeds must be credited to an authorized-dealer WST sub-account with a declaration of trade origin; 100% of foreign-currency proceeds may be retained in the IC's USD clearing accounts.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-High subject to a structural condition: Stripe does not natively support Samoa-domiciled legal entities, so the POD retail flow must be operated through a Stripe-supported foreign merchant entity (e.g., a U.S. LLC or Hong Kong-incorporated sales vehicle) or rely on PayPal as the primary rail and use a payment facilitator for card processing. PayPal accepts Samoan businesses for receiving and withdrawing USD with a verified Samoa bank account or an approved EMI destination. Offshore EMIs (Airwallex, Payoneer, Wise Business) generally accept a Samoa IC upon submission of SIFA certificates, a licensed registered-agent certification letter and an active merchant-narrative; however, Samoa's appearance on the EU Council non-cooperative list and its prior FATF heightened-monitoring status cause some EMIs to decline pure Samoan ICs, so a parallel US or Hong Kong treasury node is recommended as the primary clearing on-ramp.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The International Companies Act 1987 imposes no requirement for in-person board meetings or a physical office in Samoa. Tier-1 Samoan banks (ANZ and BSP) permit remote onboarding for ICs where the licensed Samoan registered agent certifies the corporate documents; in practice, a live video interview of the ultimate beneficial owner and at least one director is mandatory, while a physical branch visit is waived for non-resident clients. Remote-only account opening without a video interview is not accepted by the two dominant tier-1 banks. Offshshore EMI onboarding is fully remote with biometric and digital document verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated IC with no trading history and no local staff; beneficial ownership obscured by a Hong Kong corporate trustee as sole shareholder.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing issued by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA); (ii) register of directors, share register and registered-office consent, each certified by the licensed Samoan registered agent; (iii) formal introduction letter from the registered agent confirming the IC's administration, statutory filings and non-resident status; (iv) UBO declaration with passport, residential address proof and professional background; (v) written source-of-wealth statement covering the founder's capital injection path; (vi) board resolution naming account signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments arriving exclusively through Stripe and PayPal settlement rails in aggregated, platform-origin batches, creating third-party-transfer misclassification risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) executed merchant service agreements with Stripe and PayPal naming the IC or its merchant subsidiary as registered payee; (ii) 3-6 months of settlement statements from both PSPs cross-referenced to the USD account credits; (iii) order-level data export showing SKU, custom design file, print-file record and fulfillment tracking per payout; (iv) operational narrative describing the POD cycle - order received, design uploaded, print facility dispatched, no physical inventory in Samoa; (v) evidence that sales terms, invoices and storefront do not represent Samoa as place of supply.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Samoa's inclusion on international cooperation watchlists (EU Council list and prior FATF monitoring) triggering enhanced due diligence and correspondent-bank derisking.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) SIFA-issued tax exemption certificate confirming zero Samoan ring-fenced tax benefit; (ii) legal opinion from a Samoan bar member on exchange-control exemption and statutory record-keeping under the IC Act; (iii) registered agent's annual compliance certification evidencing that corporate records are available at the registered office; (iv) documentary proof of Samoa's participation in OECD EOIR and information-exchange frameworks; (v) contingency treasury plan using a New York or Hong Kong clearing intermediary where correspondent derisking is unavoidable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner or signatory matching OFAC, EU or UN sanctions screening due to common-name hits in mainland China or adjacent jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) real-time multi-list sanctions and watchlist screening output dated within 5 business days; (ii) settled identity package comprising national ID, passport and utility bill for the beneficial owner; (iii) live access to the Shopify or WooCommerce admin console evidencing real customers and historical transactions; (iv) written AML/CFT compliance declaration under Samoan law; (v) express consent to share enhanced EDD data with correspondent banks.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use an equity injection rather than shareholder debt to avoid any CBS capital-account permit and to strengthen the IC's capital base for merchant underwriting. The shareholder initiates a SWIFT MT103 from the originating bank in USD to the IC's USD account at the Samoan tier-1 bank or the approved offshore EMI, with remittance field 70-79 stating 'Capital Injection / IC Act 1987 / No WST Conversion'. The IC's director issues a certified board resolution authorizing the account opening and recording the share issuance; the bank files CBS Form ECB/1 as a notification under the exchange-control exemption rather than as an approval application. The injecting shareholder attaches the source-of-wealth package; funds remain unallocated until the SIFA share register is updated and a certificate of incumbency is produced. Amounts above USD 50,000 trigger an automatic enhanced due-diligence review, so staged injections are recommended.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: POD supplier payments to print-on-demand fulfillment partners (e.g., Printful, Printify and regional production facilities) are settled by SWIFT MT103 or MT202 from the IC's multi-currency account at ANZ or BSP in USD or EUR, referencing the supplier invoice and POD order IDs in field 70. For pre-produced bulk blank-apparel purchases above USD 50,000, an irrevocable confirmed commercial letter of credit may be opened through ANZ or BSP against a proforma invoice, certificate of origin and clean bill of lading; LC usage is otherwise atypical in POD and should be limited to margin-heavy bulk orders. Marketplace platform fees (Stripe and PayPal) are debited directly from platform balances, and residual balances are swept nightly into a USD interest-bearing treasury account via the bank's notional pooling or the EMI's virtual ledger.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/WST non-deliverable forward (NDF) executed with ANZ or BSP under CBS-authorized dealer limits, available only against documented USD receivables and used to hedge incidental WST operating expenses
USD/EUR deliverable forward with the Samoan authorized dealer to fix EUR costs of EU-based POD print suppliers, supported by original supplier invoices
USD/AUD cross-currency swap for AUD-denominated Shopify or Amazon Marketplace payouts, with quarterly rollover and underlying order-level documentation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of International Company (prescribed particulars of registered agent, registered office, directors, secretary, shareholders, and share capital)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation, every calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge of 10% of the unpaid annual fee; if the annual fee and return remain outstanding for 12 consecutive months, the Registrar may administratively strike the company off the International Companies Register, dissolving the company and voiding its limited liability protections; restoration requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and court/Registrar restoration fees.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Confirmation filing (naming each beneficial owner with a 10% or greater interest or control position)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (SFIU) and Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, submit jointly with the Annual Return by the incorporation anniversary plus 30 days; any change in beneficial ownership must be updated within 14 days of the transfer event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines per day of delinquency; non-filing is treated as an AML/CFT compliance breach, may block the annual certificate of good standing, and repeated default triggers Registrar examination and potential strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Certification of Continuing Registered Office and Registered Agent for the forthcoming year (agent attestation appended to the Annual Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the Annual Return, within 30 days of the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate penalty; absence of a licensed registered agent is a continuing statutory breach under the International Companies Act 1987 that may result in suspension of registration, a freeze on share transfers, and eventual strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a private International Company; an independent audit is mandatory only for public international companies, banks, insurance companies, and licensed financial institutions. This print-on-demand retail IC falls below the audit mandate and is not required to file financial statements with the Registrar.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as the reference framework; Samoa Local GAAP is not separately applied to International Companies, but records must be sufficient to enable a true and fair financial statement to be prepared on request.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register at its registered office and file an annual confirmation of beneficial owners jointly with the Annual Return, certified by the registered agent. Every share transfer must be recorded in the Register of Members and the UBO Register within 14 days of the transfer, and the annual confirmation must be updated to reflect any resulting change in beneficial ownership.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of shareholders' and directors' resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700 - 1,200 per year (licensed Samoa registered agent covering registered office, AML compliance officer, and coordination of the annual return filing)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - 3,500 per year if a voluntary certified audit is commissioned; not statutorily required for this private International Company

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for International Companies; 27% for resident ordinary companies
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies are exempt from income tax on non-Samoa-source income and may elect exemption from all income tax under the International Companies Act 1987 and Income Tax Act 2012. No CIT is levied on qualifying foreign-sourced income, dividends, interest, royalties, or capital gains remitted or deemed derived through an Samoa IC that maintains no local business activities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form IR8 Company Income Tax Return; electronic filing via Samoa Inland Revenue Department (IRD) Online Services portal (TAX Online), or paper lodgment to the Ministry for Revenue
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months after the end of the financial year; the tax return and assessment are due based on the company's declared accounting period. For International Companies with no Samoa-source income, a simplified annual declaration is filed with the Samoa International Companies Registry, not an IR8.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross assessable income (Samoa-source income and, if resident, any foreign income under the applicable income tax code)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the Samoa IC is wholly foreign-owned and has no Samoa-source income, leave nil and rely on the exemption under the International Companies Act; do not enter non-Samoa-source global turnover.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt income, including non-Samoa-source income of an International Company and income exempt under section 29 of the Income Tax Act 2012
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all foreign-derived trading revenue here if relying on the IC tax exemption; attach a brief schedule identifying the source territory.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions (expenses incurred in producing assessable income; excludes capital, non-arm's-length, and unsubstantiated costs)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only claim deductions against any Samoa-source income. For a pure offshore POD retail operation, such income is typically nil; any expenses claimed must be supported by invoices and proof of payment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income (assessable income less allowable deductions)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an IC deriving only foreign print-on-demand and retail income, this box should be zero. If a positive amount arises from an unintended Samoa-source supply, prepare a supporting transfer pricing / source analysis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable at the statutory rate / tax rate applied
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 0% IC rate and enter zero. If the entity falls out of IC status or the exemption is validly revoked, apply the standard corporate rate of 27% to Samoa-source profits.
The Samoa IC director or authorised non-resident officer must sign, certifying that the entity qualifies as an International Company and has no unexempted Samoa-source income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of an IR8 incurs a flat late lodgment penalty of WST 200 plus an additional penalty of 10% of the tax unpaid for each month or part-month after the deadline, capped at 100% of tax. For International Companies, failure to file the annual return or declaration may attract a WST 500 penalty, late fees of WST 50 per month, and possible strike-off or deregistration by the Registrar.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends paid by an International Company to non-residents (exempt under the International Companies Act); ordinary Samoa companies pay 15% non-resident dividend withholding tax unless reduced by treaty.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim reduced or concessional treaty withholding rates, the non-resident payee must lodge a Samoa Income Tax Treaty Relief Form, provide a Certificate of Residence (TRC) from the tax authority of the treaty jurisdiction, and submit the TRC and claim form to the Samoa Inland Revenue Department before or at the time of the repatriation. The withholding agent must retain the approved relief certificate. Samoa's DTA network includes Australia, New Zealand, Fiji, and other Pacific Forum jurisdictions; the protocol requires the payee to be the beneficial owner and, for companies, to hold not less than 10% ownership for certain dividend reductions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory royalty withholding tax is 15%; statutory interest withholding tax is 15%. Under applicable DTAs, royalty rates are reduced to 9% or 5% and interest to 10% or 0% depending on the treaty and beneficial ownership; the reduced rate requires TRC submission and treaty certification.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 5,000,000 in annual controlled transactions triggering mandatory Local File and Master File; also requires contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation where a Samoa IC enters into related-party cross-border transactions above WST 1,000,000, in accordance with Income Tax Act 2012 Part IX and OECD TP Principles.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa enacts Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019, applicable to Samoa International Companies carrying on relevant activities such as distribution and service businesses, including print-on-demand retail. The IC must demonstrate: (a) management meetings in Samoa where strategic decisions are made, (b) an adequate physical presence and qualified employees in Samoa, (c) core income-generating activities performed in Samoa, and (d) adequate operating expenditure in Samoa proportional to the level of business. Election of tax exemption does not remove ESR obligations and fails to maintain substance results in penalties and forced redomiciliation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion and deliberate misreporting of income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a nil return or tax exemption declaration while using the Samoa IC to sell physical POD goods into Samoa or maintain a permanent establishment in Samoa, or deliberately omitting assessable income from the IR8
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of up to 200% of tax understated, late payment interest of 10% per annum, a monetary penalty of up to WST 50,000, and criminal prosecution under the Tax Administration Act 2012; on conviction, fines up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment for up to 7 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign false declarations are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax under the statutory restoration and liability rules. They may face criminal fines, travel bans through the Ministry of Customs and Revenue, asset freezing orders, and disqualification of directors for up to 10 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Artificial shell company with no economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Registering an Samoa International Company for the POD business but performing all supply-chain functions, management, and sales activities outside Samoa through contractors or virtual offices; failing to maintain books, records, and a registered office in Samoa
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Non-compliance with the Economic Substance Regulations triggers a penalty of up to WST 1,000,000; the IC may be struck off the Samoa International Companies Register, have its exemption certificate revoked, and be reported to foreign tax authorities through spontaneous exchange of information. The company may also face a WST 20,000 annual default penalty.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners may be held personally liable for penalties if they caused the company's substance failures. The Registrar can issue a disqualification order, barring the individual from managing any Samoa company for 5 years, and may impose a personal fine of up to WST 50,000 for continuing non-compliance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using web payment gateways or payment aggregators (Stripe/PayPal) to accept customer funds while concealing the underlying beneficial owner, funneling funds through the Samoa IC without verifying customer identity, or structuring revenue as loans to avoid dividends and withholding tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2018, breaches carry a monetary penalty of up to WST 10 million or 3 times the value of the transaction; plus confiscation orders. Criminal conviction can impose imprisonment from 10 to 25 years for serious money laundering.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Company directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners of the Samoa IC are automatically liable for AML penalties involving their decisions. The High Court can issue a travel prohibition, freeze passports, and order repatriation of all funds; directors who knowingly process illicit proceeds are personally subject to extradition and imprisonment sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to file annual returns and misrepresentation to the Registrar
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the annual return with the Samoa International Companies Registry, failing to pay annual license fees, submitting false particulars as to directors or shareholders, or maintaining a bare nominee arrangement to conceal real ownership
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late filing penalties of WST 500 plus WST 50 per month of default; false statements to the Registrar attract a fine of WST 25,000 and, on conviction, imprisonment of up to 5 years. Persistent non-filing leads to automatic strike-off and the corporate veil removed upon restoration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who continue to trade after striking-off are personally liable for all debts and taxation of the IC; the Registrar may obtain a court order for the director's disqualification and for civil recovery from personal assets. Failure to disclose beneficial ownership can result in a custody sentence of up to 3 years.
